title: The Suburbs
physical_identity: Infinite suburban area at midnight: wet unpainted asphalt streets, stone sidewalks, furnished but unpowered houses, dead trees, mostly dead street lamps, intermittent fog.
scale_topology: Infinite flat outdoor suburb; grass fields at walkway edges lead to other levels; house interiors and back yards.
anomalies: two houses clipped inside each other when travelling far
some street lamps flicker or power on, source unknown
walkways to grass fields lead to Level 9.1; off-walkway to Level 10
lighting_sound: Midnight darkness like Level 6 but milder; street lamps usually off; fog. Sound not stated.

entities.name: Deathmoths, Smilers, Skin-Stealers, Jerry, Hounds, Transporters, Death Rats, Warning Kites, Wretches
entities.behavior: Listed as able to appear; Wretches 'many'

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: The Mangled (fog), Neighborhood Watch, Observer, plus listed common entities
hazards: streets are the most dangerous area
mental effects of arrival reported by testimony
items_communities: no groups recorded; settling is very dangerous
